name: VOYAH Automotive Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: VOYAH Automotive Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2021 and based in Wuhan, is a subsidiary of Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited. It imports and distributes electric vehicles, sedans, SUVs and MPVs among them, under the Voyah Free, Dream and Courage models, and provides repair and maintenance through authorized workshops. Customer services include factory warranties, vehicle transport, damage support, and help with test drives, orders and delivery.
